title: Observation receipt checks: refuse opened obligations unless the accounting is source_change
outcome: The unadmitted receipt check, and the shared is_accounted() the inter-turn check also uses, accept `repeat` accounting with a non-empty opened_obligations list. Engram opens obligations only for source_change (storage/work/unadmitted/accounting.rs:175-191; a repeat 'opens nothing', behavioral-control-plane.md:967). The checks refuse opened obligations for any accounting other than source_change.
acceptance: Both the unadmitted and the inter-turn receipt checks refuse a receipt whose accounting is repeat (or any kind but source_change) with a non-empty opened_obligations, and still accept source_change with obligations; unit tests show each.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
